items.title_orig: Things to do in Denver this weekend - June 25th - 28th, 2026
items.article_text:
Looking to get my list of things to do in Denver this weekend as an email? You can sign up here and you'll get it in your inbox every Thursday.
 ->>> 🗓️Have an event? Submit it here.
 ->>> I'm on Instagram u/thisweekdenver if you prefer the bite-sized version
 Please add anything you'd like to promote down below. Have a safe weekend!
 THURSDAY - JUNE 25th
 Denver Top Taco Festival @ Westminster City Park @ 6PM Don’t miss this unforgettable culinary event and indulge in a flavorful fiesta with 60+ restaurants presenting their unique taco creations, from traditional classics to innovative masterpieces.
 MORTIFIED LIVE: PRIDE EDITION @ Federal Theatre @ 7:30PM Brave adults share their hilariously embarrassing teenage journals alongside live throwback music in this special Pride edition.
